title_sq: Prane Ambasades Amerikane, Shitet Apartament 1+1, Me Planimetri Te Rregullt Dhe Orientim Perfekt !!
description_sq: Prane Ambasades Amerikane, Tek Shkolla "Osman Myderizi" Shitet Apartament 1+1, Me Orientim Dhe Planimetri Perfekte !! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 4 te nje ndertimi te ri ne faze perfundimtare. Orientohet nga Jug-Lindja duke e bere te ndricuar dhe plot diell gjate gjithe dites. Prona ka nje planimetri te shfrytezuar maksimalisht dhe shume te rregullt, e cila strukturohet ne sallonin e ndenjes, dhoma e gjumit, tualeti dhe ballkoni. Pallati ne te cilin ndodhet apartamenti dallohet per punimet cilesore, duke filluar nga fasada me termoizolim, instalimet hidraulike inkaso, instalimet e sistemit te kondicionimit multisplit, shtrimi me parket ose me pllake, dritare dopioxham termike etj.
title_en: Near the American Embassy, ​​1+1 apartment for sale, with regular layout and perfect orientation!!
description_en: Near the American Embassy, ​​at the "Osman Myderizi" School, 1+1 apartment for sale, with perfect orientation and layout!! The apartment is located on the 4th floor of a new building in the final stage. It is oriented from the South-East making it bright and full of sun throughout the day. The property has a maximally used and very regular floor plan, which is structured in the living room, bedroom, toilet and balcony. The building in which the apartment is located stands out for its quality works, starting from the facade with thermal insulation, plumbing installations, multisplit air conditioning system installations, flooring with parquet or tiles, thermal double-glazed windows, etc.
